mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_TBL ( USER_NO, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NAME, USER_AGE, USER_EMAIL, USER_PHONE, USER_SERIAL_NO, USER_TYPE, CREATED_AT, USER_NICKNAME, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_USER_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userName}, #{userAge}, #{userEmail}, #{userPhone}, #{userSerialNo}, DEFAULT, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userNickname}, DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NAME, USER_AGE, USER_EMAIL, USER_PHONE, USER_SERIAL_NO, USER_TYPE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, USER_NICKNAME, STATUS FROM USER_TBL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = DEFAULT

SELECT USER_NO, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NAME, USER_AGE, USER_EMAIL, USER_PHONE, USER_SERIAL_NO, USER_TYPE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, USER_NICKNAME, STATUS FROM USER_TBL WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{email} AND STATUS = DEFAULT
SELECT USER_NO, USER_ID, USER_NAME, USER_EMAIL, CREATED_AT FROM USER_TBL WHERE USER_NAME = #{name} AND USER_EMAIL = #{email} AND STATUS = DEFAULT
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_TBL SET USER_PW = #{userPw}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_TBL SET USER_NICKNAME = #{userNickname}, USER_EMAIL = #{userEmail}, USER_PHONE = #{userPhone}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_TBL SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TBL WHERE STATUS = '정상'
